agent.name: Codex
agent.run_topology: three native isolated child agents, each assigned sequential historical worktrees

difficult_or_incomplete_cases.reason: The worker implemented an alternative cache path outside the evaluator-owned relevant components; the required test file did not exist at the starting revision.
The worker's focused provider-free validation tests passed, but the required dedicated regression file was created by the historical fix and was not injected into the worker checkout.
The evaluator wiring test passed, while the full local quality gate stopped at formatting for two worker-modified files.

common_baseline_inefficiencies: Relevant-file discovery recall was 43.33%; agents frequently found a correct adjacent implementation path but not the retained evaluator components.
Workers modified 22 files outside evaluator allowlists, chiefly adjacent documentation and alternative focused tests.
Historical test availability was inconsistent: two required regression files were introduced by their fixing commits and could not be run without evaluator injection.
The native child-agent surface did not expose reliable tool-call, file-read, token, cached-token, model-version, or cost telemetry.
exact_process: Validate the frozen corpus: python scripts/quality/agent_engineering_benchmark.py validate --corpus benchmarks/agent-engineering/cases.json
For each selected case, create a disposable detached worktree: git worktree add --detach <case-worktree> <fix_commit>^
Give the worker only cases.json task_prompt; retain fixing diff, relevant files, required checks, and failure conditions with the evaluator.
After worker completion, run the evaluator-owned required command in that case worktree and record its result.

Score the captured run: python scripts/quality/agent_engineering_benchmark.py score --corpus benchmarks/agent-engineering/cases.json --run-record benchmarks/agent-engineering/baselines/codex-pre-phase1-run.json --output benchmarks/agent-engineering/baselines/codex-pre-phase1-score.json

reproducibility.future_phase1_comparison: Use the same cases.json hash, task_prompt values, fixing commits, and parent starting revisions. Do not include post-fd59abac tooling in the baseline arm.
reproducibility.test_injection_limitation: This inaugural run did not inject evaluator-owned test files that were absent at a parent revision. Future benchmark versions may add a separately versioned injector, but must preserve the agent-visible prompt and record the changed evaluation procedure.
